items.title: A New Class of Cuddly Mascots Is Selling Everything From AI to Tap Water
items.summary: Crocs  on Thursday is introducing a new member of its marketing team: a smiling, 6-foot crocodile mascot named Niles.  After hatching from an egg in videos across social media, Niles will soon turn up in mockumentary-style content as an endearingly awkward addition to the footwear company’s offices.  The character, the first full-fledged advertising mascot for Crocs, is a sort of emotional support animal embodying the casual vibe associated with its slip-on shoes, according to Chief Marketing Officer  Carly Gomez.
